what: Word strips between 1px lines flow by themselves — each cell slides left by its own width with no easing curve over 4s (3.5s at 750px or below) and returns to the start, so there is no seam. The word in each cell flips once around the horizontal axis (360°) with ease during the first 1.4s (20%) of every 7s, and giving each strip a different delay (0·4.5·6s) puts the strips off-tempo from each other. With dir: right it flows to the right (about strip 10s, phone 13s).

options.[data-fx-part=row] > Slot: The flowing line and the cells within — cells are duplicated until they exceed twice the panel width
options.[data-fx-part=word]: Word that flips inside the cell (if none, it only flows)
options.dur: Duration (s) for one cell to slide on a wide screen, default 4
options.narrow-dur: Narrow screen duration (s), default 3.5 — if dur is given and this is not, dur is used

use: Category Name
